_meta.role: Robotics AI Engineer – Calibration, Localization, and Mapping

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY building robotics and perception systems in C++, Python and ROS 2. Derived DH kinematic chains for UR5e and AL5B arms, wrote an SE(3) transform engine, and implemented encoder odometry with closed-loop heading correction. Runs real-time perception on compute-constrained Jetson and Arduino platforms.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Built an image-stitching pipeline combining optimized homography stitching, a custom sym6+bior3.5 wavelet bank for low-frequency noise suppression, and concurrency, reaching a PSNR of 86.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands in Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition and visualization; used GitLab for version control.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping on Jetson.
Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency; resolved 11 integration failures.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos; deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Frame Simulator — Desktop 3D Coordinate-Frame Visualizer
bullets: Wrote a custom DSL parser and SE(3) math engine in Python for local/world rotation and translation composition and recursive world-transform chaining, with an OpenGL-backed VisPy 3D viewport showing live 4x4 matrices per frame.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Built closed-loop heading correction for a 4-wheel holonomic robot on Arduino Due: derived heading from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR) and fed angular error back into rotation PWM.
